title: Battle of Fort Oswego (1814)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fort Oswego (1814)", at revision 1375554368, opens: "The Battle of Fort Oswego was a partially successful British raid on Fort Ontario and the village of Oswego, New York on 6 May 1814 during the War of 1812." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871049, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war of 1812 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
